entries.candidate: NTT Global Data Centers Berlin 1 Data Center (BER1), Nonnendammallee 15, 13599 Berlin-Spandau (Haselhorst): existing data-centre operations (up to 17.1 MW IT, 11,700+ m2)

On 23 October 2026 the de-hesse-p2 verifier refuted the same list for NTT FRA1 and FRA2: the list carries no date of its own, 'About this report' scopes the report to FY25 (1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026), and the captured file is a post-release revision with no archived copy of the 5 October version (the Internet Archive answered 'Temporarily Offline' on 23 October). NTT's location pages and 2024 fact sheets are undated, and the NTT DATA news sitemaps list no 2026 item about Berlin or Hamburg (the 5 October release does not name these sites). The site is not in the Atlas, no pending fragment or claim covers it, and no Atlas site lies within 2 km. Prepared locator: the Berlin address register (gdi.berlin.de adressen_berlin WFS, local berlin-adressen-nonnendammallee-15-wgs84.gml) returns exactly one Nonnendammallee 15 (adressid 179327, 13599, Ortsteil Haselhorst, Qualitaet A) at 52.5383118 N, 13.2373371 E (native EPSG:25833 380453.960/5822373.352; pyproj 3.7.1 round trip within 5 mm). It lies inside ALKIS parcel Haselhorst Flur 6 Flurstueck 80 (4.22 ha), next to a four-storey office building (Nonnendammallee 15) and 4 m from a four-storey 15,660 m2 former factory building on the same parcel. Nearest Atlas site: R44 Vision DC, 19.3 km. An unlocated 2023 'Data Castle BER1 Spandau' lead in the thirty-fourth holds and the separate Nexus PropCo Motardstrasse 92 procedure are not linked.
entries.reopen_condition: A primary NTT (or authority) statement itself dated within 85 days of an update that Berlin 1 at Nonnendammallee 15 is operating (for example a dated NTT release or report passage naming the site, or the Berlin 1 page bounded by an archived copy in the window); then use the Berlin address point adressid 179327 as a campus_locator.

entries.candidate: VIRTUS Wustermark campus: newer construction observation for the existing imported record (Gemeinde Wustermark 'Baustellenfest Rechenzentrum', 17 October 2026)

The page has no publication date (sitemap lastmod 2026-09-15 is an unbounded modification time), it is an invitation written before the event, and no post-event municipal or VIRTUS report was found (Wustermark news to 21 October; VIRTUS press releases to 24 September 2026 do not mention Wustermark progress). The Amtsblatt fuer die Gemeinde Wustermark 4/2026 (15 October 2026, local wustermark-amtsblatt-2026-4.pdf) records council decisions of 15 September 2026 on a declaration of intent to use the data centre's waste heat and on a heat-network feasibility study; these are heat-reuse context, not a construction observation. The existing 1 June 2026 observation stands.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated municipal or VIRTUS report of the 17 October site visit or of construction progress at Wustermark (for example a post-event Gemeinde news item or a VIRTUS release), strictly newer than 1 June 2026 and naming the campus.
